description: User report 2026-08-03: the End of Turn 03.03 check demanded a model removal from a squad that was in coherency, because it measured the bodyguard WITHOUT its attached character (19.03). Part 1: a Boyz model that is 3.7" from every squadmate but 1" from the attached Weirdboy is IN coherency — no removal is offered and END_TURN is not gated. Part 2: pushed out of the Weirdboy's reach too, the same model IS an offender — the removal dialog opens, the model is ringed on the board by a flashing CoherencyWarningVisual carrying its 2" coherency reach, and removing it clears the gate. Part 3: the markers are torn down once coherency is restored.
